content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on an application to capture data from controllers such as [version_no] and [product_name]. For testing [version_no], I use the Nettoplcsim controller emulator. Is there a comparable emulator available for [product_name]?
I have not used NetToPLCSim myself, but I would expect it to be compatible with [product_name]. [product_name] communicates over Ethernet TCP/IP using the [version_no] protocol.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a simulation or emulation solution for testing applications that interact with [product_name] controllers, similar to the Nettoplcsim available for [version_no] controllers. There is uncertainty regarding the existence of such a tool for [product_name], and responses suggest limited awareness or availability, which can complicate efficient development and testing.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an emulator or simulator solution for [product_name] controllers, akin to Nettoplcsim for [version_no], to facilitate application testing without relying on physical hardware.
